COMMAND.name: debug mfa
COMMAND.help: Configure log verbosity for MFA service

PARAM.name: mode
PARAM.help: Enable/Disable debug level logging in MFA service

DOCGEN.DESCRIPTION: Enable/Disable debug level logging in MFA service

COMMAND.name: mfa key-seed
COMMAND.help: Configure seed for generating the secret used to secure MFA data

PARAM.name: mfa-seed
PARAM.help: Key seed string

PARAM.name: encrypted
PARAM.help: Key seed is in encrypted form

DOCGEN.DESCRIPTION: Configure seed for generating the secret used to secure MFA data

COMMAND.name: mfa security-profile
COMMAND.help: Configure security profile for MFA service

PARAM.name: mfa-profile-name
PARAM.help: Name of the security profile

DOCGEN.DESCRIPTION: Configures security profile which contains the certificate for MFA service.
DOCGEN.EXAMPLE: sonic# crypto cert install cert-file home://ciamcert.pem key-file home://ciamkey.pem sonic# configure terminal sonic(config)# crypto security-profile mfa_security_profile sonic(config)# crypto security-profile certificate mfa_security_profile ciamcert sonic(config)# mfa security-profile mfa_security_profile

COMMAND.name: mfa client-secret
COMMAND.help: Configure secret for authorization header in MFA service REST API

PARAM.name: client-secret
PARAM.help: Minimum 32 characters with atleast one symbol, digit, uppercase, and lowercase

PARAM.name: encrypted
PARAM.help: Password is in encrypted format

DOCGEN.DESCRIPTION: Secret that can be used as authorization header for invoking REST API of MFA service.

COMMAND.name: no mfa key-seed
COMMAND.help: Unconfigure seed for generating the secret used to secure MFA data

COMMAND.name: no mfa security-profile
COMMAND.help: Unconfigure security profile for mfa service

COMMAND.name: no mfa client-secret
COMMAND.help: Unconfigure secret for authorization header in MFA service REST API

COMMAND.name: mfa rsa-server host

PARAM.name: hostname
PARAM.help: Hostname or IP address of RSA server

PARAM.name: port
PARAM.help: Configure RSA Server's port

PARAM.name: rsa-port
PARAM.help: Port number of the RSA SecurID server (default: 5555)

PARAM.name: client-id
PARAM.help: Configure client ID assigned by RSA SecurID service

PARAM.name: rsa-client-id
PARAM.help: Unique identifier of the system as a client, assigned by SecurID service.

PARAM.name: client-key
PARAM.help: Configure client key assigned by RSA SecurID service

PARAM.name: rsa-client-key
PARAM.help: Key associated with the client-id, assigned by SecurID service

PARAM.name: encrypted
PARAM.help: Key is in encrypted form

PARAM.name: connection-timeout
PARAM.help: Configure RSA server's connection timeout

PARAM.name: rsa-connection-timeout
PARAM.help: connection timeout (default: 20)

PARAM.name: read-timeout
PARAM.help: Configure RSA server's read timeout

PARAM.name: rsa-read-timeout
PARAM.help: read timeout (default: 120)

COMMAND.ACTION: sonic_cli_mfa patch_rsa_server ${hostname} port:${rsa-port} id:${rsa-client-id} key:${rsa-client-key} encrypted:${encrypted} connection-timeout:${rsa-connection-timeout} read-timeout:${rsa-read-timeout}

DOCGEN.EXAMPLE: sonic(config)# mfa rsa-server host rsa.securid.dell.com client-id sonicswitch.dell.com client-key rlcd09kq11f1gp5peh6s4d0c6214a4myktb31ai2bkei50924sq3l4mu6nd1s0i2 sonic(config)# mfa rsa-server host rsa.securid.dell.com port 5554 read-timeout 100

COMMAND.name: mfa rsa-server security-profile
COMMAND.help: Configure security profile that contains CA cert to validate RSA server

PARAM.name: rsa-profile-name
PARAM.help: Name of the security profile

DOCGEN.DESCRIPTION: Configure security profile that contains CA cert to validate RSA server.
DOCGEN.EXAMPLE: sonic# crypto ca-cert install home://rsa.ca.cert.pem sonic# configure terminal sonic(config)# crypto trust-store trust_store ca-cert rsa.ca.cert sonic(config)# crypto security-profile rsa_security_profile sonic(config)# crypto security-profile trust-store rsa_security_profile trust_store sonic(config)# mfa rsa-server security-profile rsa_security_profile

PARAM.name: hostname
PARAM.help: Hostname or IP address of RSA server

DOCGEN.EXAMPLE: sonic(config)# no mfa rsa-server host rsa.securid.dell.com

COMMAND.name: no mfa rsa-server security-profile
COMMAND.help: Unconfigure security profile that contains CA cert to validate RSA server
